title: Pumpkin Cream Cheese Blondies
changes_from_base: Spiced pumpkin and cream cheese swirled through a melted-butter blondie; kept chilled.
summary: Brown sugar blondies marbled with a spiced pumpkin and cream cheese swirl.
equipment: 20 cm square metal baking tin, lined with a baking-paper sling

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Preheat the oven to 180 °C (160 °C fan) and line the 20 cm square tin, leaving paper overhanging on two sides.

steps.title: Swirl
steps.text: Beat the cream cheese with 25 g brown sugar until smooth, then mix in the pumpkin and the spices.

steps.title: Batter
steps.text: Whisk the flour, baking powder and salt. In a larger bowl whisk the melted butter with the rest of the sugar, the eggs, yolk and vanilla, then fold in the dry mix.

steps.title: Marble
steps.text: Spread the batter in the tin, dollop the pumpkin mixture over and swirl through with a knife in figure-of-eight loops.

steps.title: Bake
steps.text: Bake 35-40 min, until golden and a skewer in a blondie area comes out with a few moist crumbs.

steps.title: Chill
steps.text: Cool in the tin, then chill 1 h before cutting into 16. Keep refrigerated.

tips: Use plain pumpkin purée, not pie filling.
Soften the cream cheese so the swirl is smooth.
Chill before cutting for clean edges.
Don't taste the raw dough or batter: raw flour and raw egg aren't safe to eat until baked.
storage: Keep covered in the fridge for up to 4 days.
